title: Treatise on the Parting of Plate
summary: Teaches how to read the seams of plate armor and drive a qi-fed ring through them.

title: Handbook of the Curved Flight
summary: Develops throws that bend around guards and shields and pursue a dodging foe.

title: Canon of Rings in Number
summary: Trains a thrower to loose many rings in counted volleys and to keep rings whirling as a guard.

title: A Study of the Sustained Spin
summary: Teaches keeping a ring spinning at cutting speed through a flight or a long close fight.

title: The Dual-Track Ring Manual
summary: Teaches throwing two rings from two hands along separate tracks and closing them on one target.

title: Hawk's Circuit of the Twin Rings
summary: Develops circling twin rings that return to the thrower and close on a foe from both sides.

title: Basin and River: The Paired Flight
summary: Teaches paired rings that follow one another like a river current and pour out in a wide sheet.

title: Wind-Sworn Ring Practice
summary: Teaches throwing into crosswinds on a held bearing and guarding with rings on open ground.

title: The Bearing-Taken Cast
summary: Drills holding one bearing over open plateau and sending strings of rings down it on the gale.

title: Oath of the Open Ring
summary: Teaches the sworn straight cast and the close wind-driven rush with the ring in hand.
